notes.title: 10% discount event to celebrate the release of Over the Cloud!
notes.notes:
Hi!!

To celebrate the release of our game, Over the Cloud: Lost Planet, we're doing 10% off event.

Event period: May 7th ~ May 14th (Only one week!)

We hope you have fun playing our game!

Thank you.

notes.title: Over the Cloud game release!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The SF visual novel Over the Cloud: Lost Planet has finally been released on steam!!

I want to thank everyone who has been anticipating for its launch and we hope you enjoy the game!
Thank you!

notes.title: Over The Cloud: Lost Planet release date will be delayed!
notes.notes:
Hello!!

Today we want make an announcement about the delay of the game's release date.

We found some issues during the game inspection process, 
therefore we are doing everything possible to solve the problem.

We will announce the new release date once the examination is finished.

We want to apologize to everyone who has been anticipating the release.

Thank you.
